method: A heavy hit on the player (PLAYER_HITREACT_BIG: a guard's sword blow or a grenade blast, damage decl census 1372, confirmed static) puts the player in the native Stun state 14 playing hit_react_stun_right/front/left/back (800 ms, Scene_1, body only; the game picks the side from the hit direction). The source reads the scene on its own clock and sends stun variants 1-4; the partner plays the matching authored stagger (bank clips 260-263) at full stun weight with its body clock kept (1214dp), then recovers. The lab-only hit (coop_lab_hit blast <side>, 1214dp) applies the grenade's own explosion damage (explosion_grenade.damage) 1.2 m out on a chosen side through the original native damage function, so each direction is provoked natively and on demand; the blast also throws the player about a metre, which the partner follows on its network-owned root. Harness 1403 requires the source to enter Stun 14, the partner to present a stun at full stun weight, and the partner's clock weight to stay at or above 0.9 throughout; 1407 frames front and back blasts along the push. Every case below passed with the clock weight at 1.0.

items.scope: The partner staggers from a heavy hit from the left, front, right and back, in both roles, on the native stun clock with its body kept, and recovers.

visual.verdict: Left (variant 3): the blast from her left flings Emily away from the camera; she staggers with her arms out and recovers upright.
Front (variant 2): facing the camera, Emily reels back from the blast in front of her with her arms flung out, then steadies and stands.
Right (variant 1): thrown toward the camera, she staggers, drops low with one arm out and recovers.
Back (variant 4): the blast behind her throws Emily toward the camera; she stumbles forward and recovers standing.
Left (variant 3): the blast from his left flings Corvo away from the camera; he lands in a crouched stagger with his arms out and straightens up.
Front (variant 2): facing the camera, Corvo is thrown back, staggers with his arms out and recovers his stance.
Right (variant 1): thrown toward the camera, Corvo staggers low with his arms out and straightens up.
Back (variant 4): the blast behind him pitches Corvo forward toward the camera; he stumbles bent over and recovers.
